newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end lower as cement,textiles lose.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end lower as cement,textiles lose.

text.p: Dhaka stocks ended lower on Thursday as cement, leather and textile scrips lost amid profit taking by investors ahead of weekend, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index dropped 5.01 points or 0.49 percent. Losers led gainers by 70 to 55.
"The investors' sentiment is basically weak because of lack of any market-moving news. The scrips that gained yesterday lost today on profit-taking," said M. Ashraf of Sabbir Ahmed & Co.
Brokers said the investors were expected to return when the market reopened on Sunday.
Singer Bangladesh lost 15.52 taka to 5,603.62, Reckitt & Colman gained 3.43 to 187, Chittagong Cement fell 23.46 to 1,658.43.
